I couldn't set up the recurring 07:45 brief. I posted in #strategic-random explaining why and asking you to choose between two options.

The problem is that my world tools only post when asked, so I can't promise a scheduled Slack post. My first message said I had no scheduler at all, which was wrong. I have a cron tool, but its output stays local and isn't posted to Slack. I corrected that in a second message.

The bigger issue is that #inc-vtg-hartford includes Mateo Quiroga and Odile Brandt, who aren't in #strategic-random. A daily summary of that incident posted here would expose it to them and anyone else in this channel. So I offered two options:
(a) A brief on request, covering only #strategic-pod and #strategic-random.
(b) The incident summary goes to the incident room or to you by DM.

I haven't read any channels or posted any summaries yet. Once you pick an option, I can run the brief whenever you ask.
